notes: Engine wave W1 (KNOWLEDGE/2026-11-18/215, fault F14; a known bug, failing, until W1): a resolving ability names the object its source was when it triggered, so a source that changed zones since is not 'this creature' (CR 113.7a, 400.7). Printed: Griffin Protector, 'Whenever another creature you control enters, this creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn.' Brought Back (verified, M20): 'Choose up to two target permanent cards in your graveyard that were put there from the battlefield this turn. Return them to the battlefield tapped.' A Bear enters (hold): the Protector's trigger waits. The Protector dies (a move by another effect, the destroy stand-in), and Brought Back returns it in response: the Protector on the battlefield is a new object (CR 400.7) that the waiting trigger does not name (CR 113.7a), so the pump does nothing and the new Protector stays a 2/3. Before W1 the pump landed on the new object (3/4), stronger than printed, and reachable in the M20 deal pool with two verified cards (Brought Back and any of the 16 M20 cards whose ability acts on its own source).
